Edit this existing hero scene into a much more natural real-environment editorial photograph. Use the supplied existing scene as the identity and robot design reference; preserve recognizable same people, their face/hair distinctions, and the four mascot family's white bodies, black faces, cyan eyes and colorful hair. Keep an ultra-wide 3:1 landscape composition. Replace the heavily OHO-branded showroom with a believable, lived-in contemporary creative studio: normal desks, useful books, small plants, real daylight, realistic materials, ordinary wall art and slightly imperfect casually placed work tools. Remove ALL OHO/OHO BROTHERS logos from walls, devices, cups and clothing. Laptops must be recognizable aluminum Apple MacBooks with authentic small Apple logos, normal keyboard/trackpad and realistic screens. Phones must be recognizable Apple iPhones with correct camera layout and natural screen UI. Clothes should be tasteful current designer casual fashion with small realistic recognizable fashion logos: Prada or Loewe for the men, Miu Miu or Celine for the women, subtle embroidery/print rather than oversized pasted labels. No invented OHO apparel or generic fake technology branding. Keep people photorealistic, candid focused interactions, natural proportions and realistic light; robots remain premium glossy 3D physical characters convincingly grounded on desks with contact shadows. Change the robot performances and gestures to the specific distinct actions below. Every robot must interact with a person, not simply face the camera. Avoid identical robot actions, synchronized poses, extra humans or robots, people/robots in background screens, distorted hands, excess fingers, extraneous text, banners, headlines and web UI overlays. Full subjects remain visible; no cropped faces. Camera captures a coherent authentic moment rather than a symmetrical staged advertising lineup.
